podcast-joerogan-A78LaTBt3Ss:
Biologist Bret Weinstein sits for episode 2101 of the Joe Rogan Experience, one of many visits in his run as a house contrarian. Weinstein, a former professor, built a large audience by challenging health and campus orthodoxies. Rogan gives his guests long leashes, and Weinstein uses his.

The talk ranges over the subjects Weinstein returns to: evolution as a lens on modern life, the failures he sees in experts, and the cost of dissent. Rogan probes where he can and lets the monologues run where he cannot. Listeners get Weinstein's worldview stated whole, by the man himself, at full length.
podcast-tuckercarlson-kut47PODRSs:
Qatar's prime minister speaks with Tucker Carlson about war risk, diplomacy, and his country's image. Qatar hosts talks and seeks to calm tension around Iran. The episode title notes attacks on him in Western media.

The talk opens with the World Cup and Western lectures on Qatari customs. The prime minister says critics used the games to attack his nation. From there the pair turn to talks aimed at stopping a wider war. Listeners hear how a small Gulf state presents its role as a go-between in a tense region.
